📌

Hey Builders 👋

Gaurav here, co-founder of Fastlane.

“Build it and they will come” used to be the dream.

Now? You can build faster than ever. Ship in days. But getting people to actually see what you’ve built… that’s never been harder.

Launch day:
🚀 You’re excited. You finally ship.

The next day:
📉 No views. No users. Just… silence.

We’ve been in this exact spot ourselves. Before Fastlane, we were building our own products and felt the challenge of growth first hand - constantly guessing what to post, what might work, and then spending hours creating content.

Over time, we started studying what was actually going viral, and then remixing that into our own content that performed really well, which eventually drove 50M+ views across our previous projects.

So, we built Fastlane. Fastlane is the fastest way to create viral content for your target audience. Instead of guessing what to post, it remixes videos that are already working into content for your product, whether that’s:

⚡ Slideshows
🎬 Hook + demo videos
🎭 AI UGC videos
🟩 Green screen memes

Instead of wasting hours confused by what “content” even is, you just:

👉 Swipe through trending, made-for-you content in Blitz mode (Like Tinder!)
👉 Approve what you like, or make finishing touches in our editor
👉 Publish straight to TikTok, IG Reels, and YT Shorts

One of our first ever users went from:

📈 Zero → 150 paid customers
👀 300k+ total views

Purely by posting content in Fastlane.

This is made for builders who want to do growth without the headache.

We have a huge vision for what we want to build at Fastlane, and would love your feedback and thoughts in these early days 🙏

Stop driving in circles. Enter the Fastlane 🏎️

If you’re still reading this, what’s the hardest part about creating content for you right now?
